instruction: Plug the charger into the power strip.
scene: A power strip lies flat on the table in front of the robot, with several sockets facing up. A charger plug rests on the table next to it. Both objects are within reach of the arms and sit on the table surface.
success_rule: The charger is seated fully and upright inside one of the power strip sockets, and the episode ends with both arms back at the start pose and both grippers open.
hints: Grasp the plug by its body, not by the metal prongs.
Bring the plug directly above the socket, aligned with the socket axis, before pushing it in.
Push straight down along the socket axis until the plug is seated, then let go.
Anything you are still holding when the episode ends has not been placed.
